rows.query_text: I'm so anxious and worried, I can't stop worrying about everything

I've been so anxious lately.
I can't stop worrying about everything going on in my life.
It feels like the worry never stops.
I'm afraid and scared, fear has taken hold of me

I've been feeling really afraid lately.
Fear has taken hold of me and I don't know how to shake it.
I feel scared most of the time.
I need comfort, I'm going through a hard time and feel broken

I'm going through a really hard time right now.
I feel broken and I don't know how to keep going.
I just need some comfort.
I'm exhausted and burned out, I need rest

I've been running on empty for weeks.
I'm completely exhausted and burned out.
I just need to find real rest.
